Metadata.title: Guen's travel — Travel Agency | Book Flights & Hotels at the Best Price
Metadata.description: Book your flight tickets and hotel rooms easily at the best rates. Enjoy exclusive deals and plan your trip seamlessly with Guen's travel.

Home.heroTitleFlights: Book Your Flight Tickets at the Best Price
Home.heroTitleHotels: Find and Book the Ideal Hotel for Your Stay
Home.heroSubtitleFlights: Direct access to thousands of destinations. Get the best rates on one-way, round-trip, and multi-city flights.
Home.heroSubtitleHotels: Explore a wide selection of hotels, residences, and vacation rentals at guaranteed best rates.
Home.feature1Body: We query transport companies and accommodation providers directly to bring you real-time updated deals.
Home.feature2Body: Confirm your travel booking with complete peace of mind through our encrypted transaction systems with no hidden fees.

Legal.termsIntro: These terms govern the use of the Guen's travel platform to search for and book flights and hotels with our partner providers (Travelopro, Sabre, Travelport).
Legal.termsSection1Body: Each booking is subject to the pricing and availability conditions of the provider selected at search time. The displayed price is guaranteed until payment.
Legal.termsSection2Body: Payments are processed securely and encrypted. No card data is ever stored on our servers. A non-refundable deposit may be required for some installment offers.
Legal.termsSection3Body: Cancellation terms depend on the selected fare and are shown before the booking is confirmed. Guen's travel cannot be held responsible for its providers' fare policies.
Legal.termsSection4Body: Guen's travel acts as an intermediary between the traveler and the transport/accommodation providers, who remain solely responsible for the service provided.
Legal.privacyIntro: Guen's travel takes the protection of your personal data seriously. This policy describes the information we collect and how we use it.
Legal.privacySection1Body: We collect the information needed to process bookings (identity, contact details, travelers) as well as sign-in data for your personal account.
Legal.privacySection2Body: Your data is used solely to process your bookings, inform you of their status, and improve our service. It is never sold to third parties.
Legal.privacySection3Body: The travel information required (name, dates, preferences) is shared with providers (Travelopro, Sabre, Travelport) only to fulfill your booking.
Legal.privacySection4Body: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the right to access, correct, and delete your data by contacting us.
